name: Portuguese - Portuguese for Spanish speakers A1 + A2
description:
In this course, students will acquire knowledge of Portuguese as a foreign language, which will enable them to use and understand familiar and everyday expressions and simple sentences with the support of their repertoire in other Romance Languages, especially Spanish, provided that the interlocutors express themselves clearly in the different varieties of Portuguese.
Students learn/exercise from simple to more complex structures including: asking and answering questions about the person/family; understanding and using numbers, prices and times; giving information about a place and people; making comparisons, talking about and evaluating experiences, reporting and planning everyday activities; talking about the causes and consequences of something; giving instructions; describing and narrating situations and events in the past; having simple discussions; expressing and justifying opinions. For this purpose, appropriate grammatical topics or vocabulary necessary for this purpose will be covered. In addition, strategies are taught or possibilities are shown to make the learning process in the foreign language Portuguese more effective and to improve one's own learning ability.
At the same time, the grammatical and phonetic differences between Brazilian and Portuguese language variants as well as in comparison to Spanish are dealt with in class.
prerequisites: Spanish mother tongue or Spanish as a foreign language at level B2
